thread:
sarah.ops: Quick FYI — billing update rolling out next week for minute-level quotas and new invoice labeling. Short version: unused minute credits can now roll over on a per-account basis (beta), and invoice lineitems will include a new 'meter_window' tag for easier slicing. Please read below for opt-in and timeline. :loudspeaker:

james.eng: What triggers rollover? Is it per-route or per-account?

sarah.ops: Rollover is per-account pool initially. We'll evaluate per-route in a later phase. Only applies to 'minute' quotas (not token quotas) and to hosted + dedicated customers in beta.

lina.finance: Important for finance teams — invoice label change: new fields will be 'meter_window' and 'rollover_credit_applied'. This should help reconciliation. We'll include migration notes for accounting systems.

noah.marketing: Will we be announcing externally? Need 24h heads-up before GA.

sarah.ops: Yes, beta customers will be invited today. GA tentatively 2026-05-12. External announcement coordinated by Marketing after we confirm rollout metrics. Noah, I'll loop you in.

billing-bot: [automated] Note: invoices generated after 2026-04-28 00:00 UTC will include the 'meter_window' label in preview mode for eligible accounts.

james.eng: Ops question — any runtime changes to rate-limiter? We might need to smooth bursts to avoid head-of-line issues.

sarah.ops: Good call. We are enabling 'smoothing windows' on the rate-limiter for accounts in the rollover beta to avoid sudden drops. Config docs: <https://internal.redwood.dev/billing/rollover-beta>

james.eng: Thanks. I'll add a canary flag to the rate-limiter to gate this for beta accounts only.

lina.finance: How will credits be displayed on invoices? Example snippet:

```json
"line_items": [
  {"desc": "Inference minutes (Apr)", "amount": 123.45, "meter_window": "2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-30T23:59Z"},
  {"desc": "Rollover credit applied", "amount": -12.00, "rollover_credit_applied": true}
]
```

noah.marketing: Can marketing get a plain-English explainer for customer comms? One-pager would be great.

sarah.ops: Will do. Lina, James — please review the draft before EOD. Also: opt-in flow for customers is in the Console under Billing -> Quotas -> Rollover (toggle). Opt-in will export a CSV with affected routes.

support-team: Heads-up: prepare KB article and a canned support response. We'll need to handle questions about why token quotas are not included.

sarah.ops: Perf metrics we'll watch during beta: failed requests due to smoothing, ROI on minute utilization, and invoice reconciliation errors. Expect a follow-up next Tuesday with initial metrics. Ping me if you want early access to the opt-in list.

lina.finance: Thanks — finance will run reconciliation tests with two accounts next week.

james.eng: I'll coordinate the canary deploy tomorrow morning. :rocket:

sarah.ops: Thanks everyone. If you are external-facing, please hold public comms until marketing publishes the GA blog. Internal links: <https://internal.redwood.dev/billing/rollover-beta> and <https://tickets.redwood.dev/BC-4217>. Reach out to billing-bot or me for questions. :white_check_mark:
